title: Credit load per student
statementMd:
Compute each student's total credits across their distinct course enrollments (a course counted once even if taken twice). List the five highest, ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `credits`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT s.name, SUM(c.credits) AS credits FROM students s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT student_id, course_id FROM enrollments) x ON x.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON c.id = x.course_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY credits DESC, s.name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
